hooks.name: Log Spec Task Completions
hooks.description: Appends a log entry to docs/kiro-log.md after each spec task completes, capturing the date, spec name, task title, and placeholders for features used and notes

action.command:
bash -c '
# Read session context from stdin
context=$(cat)

# Extract spec name and task title from JSON
spec_name=$(echo "$context" | jq -r ".spec.name // \"unknown\"")
task_title=$(echo "$context" | jq -r ".task.title // \"unknown\"")

# Get current date
date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)

# Ensure docs directory exists
mkdir -p docs

# Create file with header if it doesn'\''t exist
if [ ! -f docs/kiro-log.md ]; then
  echo "# Kiro build log" > docs/kiro-log.md
  echo "" >> docs/kiro-log.md
fi

# Append log entry (template for manual completion)
echo "- $date | spec: $spec_name | task: $task_title | Kiro features used: [TODO] | notes: [TODO]" >> docs/kiro-log.md
'
